AN ORDINANCE TO ENACT, ORDAIN, AND ADOPT CHAPTER 10 OF THE TOWN OF SHARPSBURG CODE OF ORDINANCES ENTITLED “ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES”; TO PROVIDE FOR ITS CODIFICATION; TO IMPOSE AN EXISE TAX UPON DISTILLED SPIRITS; TO AUTHORIZE THE ISSUANCE OF LICENSE FOR SALE OF DISTILLED SPIRITS BY THE DRINK; BY THE DRINK TO PROVIDE FOR SANCTIONS AGAINST LICENSEES FOR SALES TO MINORS AND OTHER OFFENSES; TO CREATE REQUIREMENTS FOR A “REASONABLE LICENSEE” AND TRAINING FOR SERVERS AND MANAGERS; TO PROVIDE PROCEDURES FOR SUSPENSION/REVOCATION OF LICENSE AND SERVER PERMITS; TO PROVIDE FOR SERVER PERMITS AND REQUIREMENTS THERFORE; TO PROVIDE FOR CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS FOR AND RESTRICTIONS UPON DRINKING IN PUBLIC; TO PROVIDE FOR TYPES OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE LICENSES; TO PROVIDE FOR APPLICATIONS, CONTENTS, AND INVESTIGATION OF APPLICATIONS FOR LICENSEES; TO PROVIDE FOR DISTANCE RESTRICTIONS BETWEEN ALCOHOL DEALERS AND CHURCHES AND SCHOOLS; TO PROVIDE FOR LICENSEES QUALIFICATIONS; TO PROVIDE FOR PROCEDURES AND PROCESSES FOR GRANTING OF LICENSES; TO PROVIDE FOR REGULATIONS FOR EMPLOYEES OF LICENSEES; TO PROVIDE FOR RESTRICTIONS UPON SERVERS OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES; TO PROVIDE FOR SERVING HOURS OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES; TO ESTABLISH LICENSE FEES; TO PROVIDE FOR SEVERABILITY; TO PROVIDE FOR PENALTIES; TO PROVIDE FOR REPEAL OF CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; TO PROVIDE AN ADOPTED EFFECTIVE DATE; TO PROVIDE FOR OTHER LAWFUL PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the Town of Sharpsburg did execute a resolution to call a special election referendum to submit to the qualified voters of the Town of Sharpsburg the question: “Shall the governing authority of Sharpsburg be authorized to issue license to serve distilled spirits for beverage purposes by the drink, such sales to be for consumption only on the premises? ”; and

WHEREAS, a special election was held on July 20, 2004, and the question passed by a majority of the qualified voters of the Town voting thereon; and

WHEREAS, it is the legal requirement of O.C.G.A. §3-4-92 that the Town Council enact an ordinance authorizing and regulating the sale of distilled spirits for beverages purposes by the drink or on-premise consumption; and

WHEREFORE, BE IT AND IT IS HEREY ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND TOWN COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF SHARPSBURG, GEORGIA, AND BY THE AUTHORITY THEREOF:
5: The foregoing constituting the amended Chapter 10 of the Code of Ordinances of the Town of Sharpsburg , which statement authorizes the licensing and regulation of the selling and serving of distilled spirits by the drink for on premises consumption, and the same is hereby ORDAINED AND ADOPTED as Chapter 10 of the Code of Ordinances of the Town of Sharpsburg to be entitled “Alcoholic Beverages,” and the following shall be codified at and as

- (a) This chapter has been enacted in furtherance of the police powers of the Town and in accordance with a plan designed for the purposes, among others, of promoting the health and general welfare of the community, to establish reasonable standards for the regulation and control of the licensing and sales of alcoholic beverages, to protect and preserve schools and churches, to give effect to existing land use and to preserve certain residential areas, with reasonable consideration, among others, to the character of the areas and their peculiar suitability for particular uses, the congestion in the roads and streets, and with a general view of promoting desirable living conditions and sustaining stability of neighborhood and property values, and to protect against the evils of concentration of ownership or control of the retail outlets for alcoholic beverages or to prevent undesirable persons from controlling the retail alcoholic beverage industry.
